title: Profile
description: What you care about. The judge uses this to drop ideas from excluded areas and to score extra axes you define.

report_language.description: Language of reports as a short code, e.g. en, uk, de.

priority.description: Areas you are most interested in. Empty means 'anything'.

excluded.description: Areas to drop entirely. An idea from one of these is rejected.

exceptions.description: Narrow topics allowed even though they fall inside an excluded area.

custom_axes.description: Optional extra scores (1–5) you want on every report, e.g. 'fits my job search'.

question.description: What the judge should answer when scoring this axis.

affects_selection.description: If true, the score is added to the total used for picking top ideas. If false, it is shown for information only.
